properties.site-address: Bungalow and New Dolphin Garage, Front Street, Newbiggin-by-the-Sea
properties.notes: Redevelopment opportunity for existing employment and commercial land within settlement. Reserved matters consent approved for demolition, remediation and redevelopment of 14 homes (11/02989/REM). It is anticipated that this will be delivered gradually with final completion expected in 2025/26. The permission has been implemented but no start has been made on construction of dwellings to date. Until housebuilding commences, the site will remain on the BF Register. Also see initial outline consent (07/00557/OUT).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
